summary: Iteration 52 verification of the two reported fixes. BUG-2 (frontend .map TypeError on Programs/Marketing) is CONFIRMED FIXED: homepage marketing-programs renders 3 program cards and /programs renders the Core Series with ZERO console errors and no 'map is not a function'. BUG-1 (migration off emergentintegrations to the official Stripe SDK) is only PARTIALLY verified: the backend imports cleanly (no ModuleNotFoundError), /api/health, /api/settings/public, /api/programs and /api/assistant/chat all return 200, and the webhook endpoint behaves sensibly — BUT Stripe Checkout session creation is now BROKEN (HTTP 500) for both one-time and subscription flows because the only Stripe secret available in this pod is the Emergent placeholder key STRIPE_API_KEY=sk_test_emergent, which the official SDK rejects (stripe._error.AuthenticationError: Invalid API Key provided: sk_test_****gent). Reproduced end-to-end in the UI: student → /passes → 'Buy drop-in class' → POST /api/checkout/session 500 → 'Checkout failed' toast; PayPal buttons are not rendered (provider unavailable), so there is currently NO working card checkout path. Backend pytest: 7/10 pass, the 3 failures are exactly the Stripe session-creation/status cases.

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error. Traceback: routers/payments.py:306 create_checkout -> :25 _create_onetime_session -> stripe.checkout.Session.create -> stripe._error.AuthenticationError: Invalid API Key provided: sk_test_****gent. The env/DB key is the Emergent placeholder 'sk_test_emergent' (backend/.env STRIPE_API_KEY; db.settings.stripe_secret_key is unset) which only worked through the emergentintegrations proxy. After the migration a REAL Stripe test secret (sk_test_51...) must be configured in Admin→Settings or env, otherwise every card checkout fails.

500 as well. stripe_subscriptions_enabled is unset in db.settings, so membership falls through to the one-time path and hits the same invalid-key AuthenticationError. The subscription-mode code path (_create_subscription_session) could therefore NOT be exercised at all — subscription checkout remains unverified.

No error handling around _create_onetime_session: the except block only releases reserved store credit and re-raises, so any stripe.StripeError surfaces as a bare 500 'Internal Server Error' with no actionable detail. Wrap in `except stripe.StripeError as e: raise HTTPException(502, f'Stripe error: {e.user_message or str(e)}')` (the subscription path already does this).
Could not be verified (Session.retrieve untested) because no session can be created with the invalid key. Invalid-session-id handling was verified: returns 404, no 500.

minor.issue: stripe_webhook_secret is unset in this environment, so the endpoint falls back to parsing the body WITHOUT signature verification and returns 200 for arbitrary unsigned JSON — a spoofable fulfillment path (an attacker could POST a fake checkout.session.completed). Acceptable only for staging; consider requiring the secret when an env flag/prod mode is on.

allow_credentials=False with allow_origins default '*', while /api/auth/login sets an httpOnly access_token cookie — the cookie can never be sent cross-origin, so the cookie session is effectively dead weight (app relies on the Bearer token in localStorage). Playbook expects allow_credentials=True + explicit origins.

No OpenAI key configured (db.settings.openai_api_key unset), so the assistant answers from the scripted graceful fallback ('Could you tell me a bit about your goals...'). The official-OpenAI-SDK path itself is therefore NOT exercised in this environment — only the no-key fallback is proven.

integration_issues.flow: Stripe card checkout (student → /passes → Buy drop-in class)
integration_issues.issue: POST /api/checkout/session returns 500; user stays on the page with a generic 'Checkout failed' toast. No card payment path works because the PayPal buttons are also not rendered (payment provider reports PayPal unavailable). Only store-credit-only checkout still completes (bypasses Stripe).

issues: Mixed currencies in one list (€15, €47 next to $199, $22) — historical transactions keep their original 'usd' currency so the panel renders inconsistent symbols; consider normalising/displaying the stored currency explicitly.

action_items: CRITICAL: configure a real Stripe TEST secret key (sk_test_51...) — via Admin→Settings stripe_secret_key or backend/.env STRIPE_API_KEY — because 'sk_test_emergent' is an emergentintegrations-proxy placeholder that the official SDK rejects. Until then ALL Stripe checkout (one-time + subscription) returns 500 and the UI shows 'Checkout failed'.

Wrap _create_onetime_session in create_checkout with `except stripe.StripeError` → HTTPException(502/400) with a readable detail, so key/config problems surface as a clear message instead of a bare 500 (and so store credit release + error reporting are consistent with the subscription path).

Re-run subscription-mode verification after a valid key is set AND stripe_subscriptions_enabled is turned on — the subscription code path (_create_subscription_session) is currently completely unexercised.
Decide on webhook hardening: require stripe_webhook_secret (reject unsigned bodies) outside staging — today unsigned garbage JSON is accepted with 200.
Optional: set allow_credentials=True with explicit CORS origins or drop the httpOnly cookie; configure openai_api_key if the real LLM assistant path should be tested.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/payments.py::create_checkout — the one-time branch has no StripeError handler (unlike the membership branch at line 268), so provider/config failures become 500s. Also `except Exception: await _release_store_credit(...); raise` re-raises the raw SDK error into the response.

routers/payments.py::_stripe_api_key falls back to os.environ STRIPE_API_KEY without validating the format; a cheap guard (key.startswith('sk_') and len>20, else HTTPException(503, 'Stripe not configured')) would make misconfiguration obvious instead of a 500.
routers/payments.py::stripe_webhook silently skips signature verification when no secret is set — make this conditional on an explicit staging flag.
Marketing.jsx Programs + Programs.jsx duplicate the same 4-way array-normalisation logic; extract a shared `asArray(data, keys)` helper in lib/api to avoid drift (the fix itself is correct).

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the Stripe 500: the migration replaced emergentintegrations' StripeCheckout (which routed through Emergent's proxy and accepted the sentinel key 'sk_test_emergent') with the official Stripe SDK, which authenticates directly against api.stripe.com. The pod's only credential is still the sentinel value, so stripe.checkout.Session.create raises stripe._error.AuthenticationError ('Invalid API Key provided: sk_test_****gent'). Because create_checkout's one-time branch re-raises any exception unhandled, FastAPI returns 500 and the frontend shows a generic 'Checkout failed' toast. Repro: POST /api/checkout/session {item_type:'product', item_id:<any product id>, origin_url:<base>, apply_credit:false} with a student Bearer token → 500; traceback visible in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log at payments.py:25. Mitigation: provision a real Stripe test secret key (Admin→Settings stripe_secret_key or STRIPE_API_KEY env) and add a StripeError→HTTPException mapping plus a key-format guard so misconfiguration returns 503 'Stripe not configured' instead of 500.
